mapper.sql: id, version_id, file_id, version_number, version_type, version_tag, version_name, version_remark, change_summary, file_path, file_size, file_md5, file_sha256, storage_url, parent_version_id, branch_id, is_current, is_latest, is_deleted, created_user_id, created_user_name, created_time, updated_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_tbl_file_version ( version_id, file_id, version_number, version_type, version_tag, version_name, version_remark, change_summary, file_path, file_size, file_md5, file_sha256, storage_url, parent_version_id, branch_id, is_current, is_latest, is_deleted, created_user_id, created_user_name, created_time, updated_time ) VALUES ( #{versionId}, #{fileId}, #{versionNumber}, #{versionType}, #{versionTag}, #{versionName}, #{versionRemark}, #{changeSummary}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{fileMd5}, #{fileSha256}, #{storageUrl}, #{parentVersionId}, #{branchId}, #{isCurrent}, #{isLatest}, #{isDeleted}, #{createUserId}, #{createUsername}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM file_tbl_file_version WHERE version_id = #{versionId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM file_tbl_file_version WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY version_number DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM file_tbl_file_version WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND is_current = 1 AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM file_tbl_file_version WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY version_number ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM file_tbl_file_version WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE file_tbl_file_version SET is_current = #{isCurrent}, updated_time = NOW() WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(version_number) FROM file_tbl_file_version WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT MAX(version_number) FROM file_tbl_file_version WHERE branch_id = #{branchId} AND is_deleted = 0

WITH RECURSIVE version_chain AS ( SELECT FROM file_version WHERE version_id = #{versionId} AND is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT v. FROM file_version v INNER JOIN version_chain vc ON v.version_id = vc.parent_version_id WHERE v.is_deleted = 0 ) SELECT * FROM version_chain ORDER BY version_number ASC

WITH RECURSIVE path_from AS ( SELECT , 1 AS depth FROM file_tbl_file_version WHERE version_id = #{fromVersionId} AND is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT v., p.depth + 1 FROM file_tbl_file_version v INNER JOIN path_from p ON v.version_id = p.parent_version_id WHERE v.is_deleted = 0 ), path_to AS ( SELECT , 1 AS depth FROM file_tbl_file_version WHERE version_id = #{toVersionId} AND is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT v., p.depth + 1 FROM file_tbl_file_version v INNER JOIN path_to p ON v.version_id = p.parent_version_id WHERE v.is_deleted = 0 ) SELECT * FROM path_from UNION SELECT * FROM path_to ORDER BY depth DESC
SELECT FROM file_tbl_file_version WHERE created_time < #{dateTime} AND is_deleted = 0 AND is_latest = 0 ORDER BY created_time ASC
